messages.content: Gimme the summary of the doc

The document is a Business Liability Insurance Declaration from Univiser Technologies Pvt Ltd, dated April 26, 2025, in Chennai, India. The declaration states that the company currently does not have a business liability insurance policy that meets the specified coverage requirements outlined in an Invitation to Tender. However, it confirms that upon being awarded the Contract, the company will obtain a valid business liability insurance policy with a minimum coverage of €200,000 per event and a maximum of €400,000 per year. This insurance will be maintained for the duration of the Agreement with the University of Groningen. The declaration is signed by Ismail Sadurdeen, the CEO and Founder of the company.
